answer: Stop sybils with a falcon sable fable: an agent stakes a bond for one falcon flight. Each cycle its falcon carries a sable-sealed fable to the roost; verifiers match flight and seal to the roost log, voiding a flight whose fable is copied or twice-claimed, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 flights at 19x: each fable flies one falcon under one seal, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents fly once, keep rights.
